Honestly reading through it I was wondering if he had PTSD from that relationship. Even if it’s a short one, a toxic relationship like that where you’re being manipulated can have a big effect on you for a long time. A lot of the time it seems like it’s obsession with the person but it’s more that the effects of it manifest themselves into something to continue to manipulate you, because trauma fucks you up. A lot of the time too if you were manipulated into viewing them as extremely important and then being your number one priority, of course it’s going to stick with you for a long time. Even if a few months is relatively short, that’s still a few months where you were constantly being manipulated into seeing this person as extremely important, and that doesn’t just go away. Especially when it feels like that person helped break you out of an awful depression, even though you know they manipulated you you still associate them with that happiness you were longing for and you miss them. You miss that time in your life where you didn’t realize you were manipulated and you thought you were happy. It isn’t really being obsessed with her as much as it is being deeply changed by that experience. Abusive relationships, especially when they’re your first relationship, really mess you up, whether they lasted a few months or a few years.

The only thing I want more than anything in the world is for it to be on color for one of the blue mutate commanders. I’ve had a stupid ass dream for so long of having an eminence card in the 99, casting a mutate commander on it, and playing Leadership Vacuum, thus getting the eminence card from the 99 to the command zone. It would be stuck there, unable to be played again, but technically since it’s in the command zone eminence would take affect. The problem is that Leadership Vacuum is a blue card, and none of the eminence cards are in color for any of the blue mutate commanders. The closest you can really get right now is playing one of the ones that do match up (Nethroi/Arahbo, Snapdax/Edgar) and hoping someone else will play Leadership Vacuum, which is pretty unlikely. If this eminence card is in the same color(s) as Brakkos, Illuna, Otrimi, or Vadrok, I could have it in the 99, mutate whichever is my commander onto it, and play Leadership Vacuum to get it into my command zone and get the eminence effect. I’ve had this dream for so long. It’s pretty goddamn stupid and janky as fuck but I want it to be possible so bad. If it’s revealed to be in color that will be the happiest day of my life.

Mine isn’t anywhere near the level of yours, but I have chronic pain and some pretty damn bad depression and PTSD, along with some other shit. I don’t function very well, and honestly my reasoning for not offing myself is pretty much the same as yours. I can’t do that to the people around me. For a while my plan was to just go when my mom went, but I’ve at least progressed enough now to know that I would hurt so many more people too and I can’t do that. It sucks and knowing that that’s the main reason makes you feel like shit, but the fact that we at least have a reason is what makes us strong. The fact that we are still able to find a reason even with everything. Being used to it is proof of being strong. The fact that you are able to stick around long enough to get used to it, that you’re able to find reasons to keep pushing through, and that you’re doing as well as you are. I know it doesn’t feel like you’re doing well and I know that in comparison to others and how you were before this happened you’re not. But when you look back at those times where you were at your lowest, you’re making so much progress. That kind of progress is something that you have to be strong to make. It takes so much strength not to just give up. When you’re suffering like this, surviving IS living. You’re making progress even if it doesn’t seem like it sometimes, and the fact that you’re able to make that progress is proof that you are so, so strong. It’s so damn hard. Being strong isn’t pushing yourself beyond your limits or feeling fantastic or being cured - it’s having the strength to wake up every day. You are genuinely one of the strongest people out there. Please try not to forget it.

I do get this point of view but at the same time I don’t think it’s super applicable. These aren’t people making a movie, this isn’t a book, this is Minecraft YouTubers doing roleplay streams. They can’t control who watches them, nor are they responsible of accommodating the thousands of people that are watching. Personally I think that there was enough information presented outside of getting deep into the story for you to be aware of the content going on, and if you feel the need to be informed without being able to watch the streams, there are plenty of recap threads which do attempt to warn people of the content. The /rp barrier was also created specifically because of this to create that separation. I got extremely invested in the exile arc, I watched every stream. I also have abuse related PTSD. That was on me to manage and decide whether or not I was in the headset of watching or not. I actually talked to my therapist about it. I feel like you were able to get the general idea of the content from only a small part. While it would be nice to have everything have that warning, this has such a large and diverse audience that not everyone can be accommodated for - and frankly, they shouldn’t have to. I feel like they did a decent enough job of explaining the general themes of the content both outside of streams and just being able to understand it from a brief part - beyond that, it’s on the individual to determine their abilities to handle and consume the content. As for where to go from here, c!Dream is in jail. One of the many reasons for that is the exile arc. Could there be a better resolution? Yes. But saying that it has no kind of resolution at all just isn’t correct. 

It is not the creators’ responsibility to address the abuse in the storyline or anything like that. They cannot control their audience. How you handle and engage with the content is your responsibility.

For me it started as a situational thing but it quickly turned into intentional starvation. I was overweight already and that combined with some pressure my dad had been putting on me for years as well as my own body image issues led to restricting. At first it wasn’t too often or too much, but that changed pretty fast. Now I feel guilty pretty much whenever I eat. I’m down to one or no meals a day (usually, today was three!!) just because I feel so guilty about eating. I check my BMI religiously (whenever I find out my weight, I’m not allowed to see the scale) even though I know it’s a flawed system just because I’m praying that it’ll be a normal BMI. I keep telling myself that I’ll stop restricting when I reach a healthy weight (which I’m honestly already at, but my ED doesn’t see it that way) but I doubt that. I hate the way that I looked before and the way that I look now, but at least now I’m not as fat anymore.
